results.title: NJPW Road to Destruction 2026 - Day 11
results.overview: The eleventh and final night of Road to Destruction 2026 took place on September 23, 2026, at Kitagas Arena Sapporo 46 in Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan.

results.title: Bayang
results.overview: Ayu (16) becomes obsessed with the beauty standards she sees in social media and magazines. Covering her mirror with notes about what it means to be “beautiful,” she pushes herself to change her appearance through makeup, dieting, and other painful efforts. As her reflection disappears behind these expectations, so does her sense of self. Overwhelmed, Ayu escapes to the beach, where an unexpected encounter with the girl she idolizes challenges her beliefs and reveals a different understanding of beauty and self-acceptance.

results.title: One Last Night
results.overview: On the eve of a life-changing separation, two best friends spend one last night together in Rio de Janeiro, determined to finish the song they have been writing before their paths take them in different directions.

results.title: The Hunted
results.overview: Three deadly stories of pursuit collide in this horror-thriller anthology: a concussed runner and her dog are stalked in the wilderness, a serial killer targets an abusive man, and bank robbers turn on one another over a priceless score.

results.title: Cheekatilo
results.overview: When crime anchor Sandhya’s best friend is found dead under suspicious circumstances, she embarks on a dangerous investigation that collides with a dark past. As secrets unravel, Sandhya must face her trauma and rise as a fearless voice for the silenced.

results.title: Liquid States
results.overview: Nina and Miki travel to a small village in Mazuria to spend the summer with their long-estranged father. Their mother accepted a job offer in the US, ignoring the protests of Nina who blames her father for breaking up the family and wants nothing to do with him.

results.title: La corta vida de las flores
results.original_title: La corta vida de las flores
results.overview: As they prepare for the arrival of their first child, a middle-aged musician and florist are forced to confront a long-buried memory that may redefine the truth of their relationship.

results.title: Election Day
results.overview: On the election night that will decide her political fate, MP Renata Innocenti sees her career teetering on the brink of ruin when her partner becomes the center of a massive media scandal. Amidst family tensions and political chaos, Renata must fight to save everything she has built.

results.title: England 2006: The Golden Generation
results.overview: Documentary that explores why the men's England football team did not fulfil their potential at the 2006 World Cup, including insight and reflection from key members of the 'Golden Generation'.

results.title: Pluto
results.overview: Vicky, down on his luck after multiple failed businesses, accidentally befriends an alien named Pluto. Both considered losers, they navigate life together while a gang of thugs attempts to capture the alien.

results.title: Better Future
results.overview: After four years as an immigrant in the United States, Julio, who works as part of the cleaning staff at a hospital, struggles to stay sober. Separated from his daughter and with his marriage in crisis, he searches for a fresh start amid the hardships of his daily life.

results.title: Martin Luther King Jr.: Enemies of the Dream
results.original_title: Martin Luther King Jr.: Enemies of the Dream
results.overview: The fight for racial equality came at a cost. Martin Luther King Jr. rose as a powerful voice for justice, yet was seen as a threat by some. Declassified records fuel questions about whether more lay behind the silencing of his voice.

results.title: Heirlooms
results.overview: A young family goes to see their dying patriarch, only for old familial nightmares to resurface.

results.title: Non-Migrants
results.overview: In a small Bulgarian town a young man faces a crisis when his girlfriend plans to emigrate abroad. Angered, he breaks into the abandoned local factory and starts working without any specific purpose, ideology, or political agenda. But this unusual form of “protest” attracts media attention and may unexpectedly restore lost faith and friendships.

results.title: NJPW New Japan Cup 2026 - Day 10
results.overview: The tenth night of New Japan Cup 2026 took place on March 17, 2026, at Big Palette Fukushima in Koriyama, Fukushima, Japan and featured two quarterfinal matches.

results.title: Insidious Possession
results.overview: A former A-student begins lashing out in school and at home. Her parents reach out to their priest for help. Only to realize that the girl is possessed by the devil. Now the unexperienced priest must fight for the girl’s soul and the souls of the entire town.

results.title: Cinemanía
results.overview: A film director for whom everything goes wrong, a psychologist obsessed with her ex-boyfriend, a family threatened by a plague of rats, a production company with a dark secret, nuns and CIA agents. 'Cinemanía' is a choral comedy about several characters who try to find happiness.

results.title: 12 Warriors
results.overview: A dozen top warriors from around the world are kidnapped and forced to participate in fight-to-the-death survival games. Affairs are overseen by a disgraced and sociopathic former Russian intelligence officer who has built a shadowy organization with a clientele of crime bosses, politicians, billionaires, and members of the global elite.
